name: scansnap-scanner-gateway
transport: HTTP on 127.0.0.1 only, Authorization: Bearer <scanner token>

response.X-SSC-Contract: contract version of the server, on every answer

request.X-SSC-Contract: contract version of the client; missing means 1

history.1: finish(success=true) refused with 409 when the browser authority or the scan window was gone; the reservation stayed reserved until a restart.
history.2: finish answers 200 recovery_required with a reason instead; no contract endpoint before 2; X-SSC-Contract header; reservations without scanner activity for 12 min become recovery_required (orphaned). No release, no deletion.

compatibility.server 2, client 1: accepted (min_client 1). Unsafe ends become recovery_required instead of hanging; a version-1 client reports the unexpected answer as an error and stages nothing, as before.
compatibility.server 1, client 2: the client finds no contract endpoint (404) and treats the server as version 1: a refused finish stays a refusal; behaviour as before.
compatibility.server 2, client 2: recovery_required is an expected outcome; the client stages nothing and logs the reason.
